text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: For some reason, my joints hurt… My friends are worried about me, but I'm still fine…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I keep telling myself that and keep my pain a secret. But eventually, my body stops moving the way I want it to. What if I can't run anymore?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: …I end up crying like a baby, but Trainer is there to make me feel better and says everything will be okay.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: And everything really is okay! I can hardly believe it, but it seems I'm just going through a growth spurt!
